analysis: The trial succeeded operationally but did not improve the target metric: pinned-host macro validation HR@10 was 0.6213 versus the prior 0.6225, a decrease of 0.0012. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.670, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.650, Electronics 0.465, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.700, with 200 validation users each. Electronics improved from the stated prior 0.435 by 0.030, but this did not yield a macro improvement. The result supports further investigation of local history context, without establishing a reliable overall benefit or its cause. Allocated GPU time was 1051.27 seconds; no test metrics were supplied.
code_summary: Trains one independent network per category. Each combines three-layer LightGCN propagation with tied item embeddings, learned item bias, recency-aware history attention, and a learned user/history fusion gate. The added residual causal block applies a width-64, kernel-3 Conv1d with explicit left padding, GELU, and projection to the embedding dimension. Masked contextualized history vectors supply attention keys and values. Training retains prefix supervision, minibatch supervised-edge masking with graph renormalization, sampled-negative cross-entropy, and embedding regularization. Inference strictly restores one selected checkpoint per category, including architecture metadata, and preserves all four dataset routes. Diagnostics cover masking, gradients, causal behavior, empty histories, and checkpoint-reload parity.
